source_commit_note: source tree inspected as the behavior reference for the pinned 1.6.0 artifacts; it is AHEAD of the 1.6.0 release, so installed-binary behavior wins on differences (verified example: no `ui` subcommand in the 1.6.0 platform package while the source tree has one). Re-check `--help` output of the actual artifact when upgrading.
dist_shasum_note: the main npm package is a thin installer: dist/ ships only .d.ts types, the compiled app lives in per-platform optionalDependencies
platform_dist_shasums_note: linux-x64 / darwin-arm64 / other targets: add shasums here when first prepared on that platform
engines_note: every platform bundle vendors a general-purpose Node 24 at its root (node.exe / node); the wrapper runs BOTH the serve child and the first-index helper on it because the library needs the built-in node:sqlite module (Node 22.5+). The system Node (>=20) only runs this wrapper and the thin npm fetch.

bundle_layout.posix_note: bin/codegraph is a POSIX shell wrapper that execs the same command; the wrapper never uses it (it would re-inject CODEGRAPH_HOST_PPID)

env_forced.CODEGRAPH_DIR: <single directory name under repo root, chosen by wrapper>

index_dir_naming.constraint: CODEGRAPH_DIR accepts a single directory name under the project root only
